known_limitations: Raw Riskfolio CVaR weights before score tilt are not saved in V5.16 outputs.
Exact score-tilt multipliers are not saved in V5.16 outputs.
Exact pre-cash, post-cash, pre-turnover, and post-turnover ticker-level attribution is not saved in V5.16 outputs.

final_holdings.PlainEnglishExplanation: SGOV is the cash/T-bill sleeve. The model uses it when it does not want the full portfolio in risk ETFs, usually because market breadth is weaker or the selected ETF basket is too volatile.
